courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明石海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「設計風速與風場特性」與「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明石海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" and "Spring-mounted section-model testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Akashi Kaikyo Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以設計風速、相似律、節段與全橋模型試驗，確認長跨橋梁在渦振、馳振與顫振前保有足夠風速餘裕；明石海峽大橋則以以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on design wind speed, similitude and section and full-bridge model tests that confirm long-span bridges keep enough margin against vortex shedding, galloping and flutter; Akashi Kaikyo Bridge centres on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面高度設計風速」與「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明石海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck-level design wind speed” and “Truss flutter margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
history.text: 1940 年 7 月 1 日通車的塔科馬海峽橋，以 8 呎深板梁加勁約 853 m 的主跨，同年 11 月 7 日在約 40 mph 的風中扭轉振動崩塌；華盛頓大學 Farquharson 當時已以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型研究其振動，並建議導流措施，但未及實施。由 Ammann、von Kármán 與 Woodruff 組成的委員會調查後，氣動力在橋梁設計中的地位大幅提升，風洞試驗逐漸成為長跨橋梁的必要程序，1950 年 10 月 14 日新橋通車；1970 年代 Scanlan 等人提出以顫振導數描述橋面自激氣動力。1998 年完工的明石海峽大橋以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證抗風設計，2010 年伏爾加格勒大橋的振動事件則提醒完工後仍需監測與改善。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的試驗或設計文件。
history.textEn: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge, opened on 1 July 1940 with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted itself apart in a wind of about 40 mph on 7 November that year; Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying its motion with a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model and had recommended aerodynamic fixes that were never installed. After the board of Ammann, von Kármán and Woodruff investigated, aerodynamics gained a central place in bridge design and wind-tunnel testing became a standard step for long spans; the replacement bridge opened on 14 October 1950, and in the 1970s Scanlan and others introduced flutter derivatives to describe self-excited deck forces. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge, completed in 1998, verified its wind design with full-model wind-tunnel testing, while the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge showed that monitoring and remedies are still needed after completion. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's test or design documents.
